en.title: Remove Silence from Audio – Interactive HF Space Demo
en.hook: Automatically strip out silent gaps in your audio with this interactive Gradio-based demo – try it live now!
key_takeaways: Detects and removes silent segments in audio automatically.
Interactive Gradio UI for easy one‑click processing.
Web‑based, no installation required – runs directly in your browser on Hugging Face Spaces.
